label: early original-phase steps (t=2-5) after a prefix rich in h/x/e/f/d/b/3/1
explanation: Fires mostly in the original (input) phase (88% of mass), concentrated at t=2-5 (85% of mass, peak t=3); never at t=0, rarely at the delimiter or in the copy phase. Within that window it depends on which tokens came earlier: prefixes containing h, x, e, f, d, b, 3 or 1 (strong prev_tok/prev2_tok/first_tok lift, e.g. first_tok=h 4.5x) raise the rate. The current input also matters: t, x and o give the highest rates and the top activations (often near max on x/t/o right after h/x). Requiring at least 2 such prefix tokens covers ~75% of mass but precision is only ~0.11, and adding a current-token condition raises dev F1 only to ~0.29. Behaves like a distributed, graded response to the prefix tokens, not a crisp rule. Copy-phase firing (~11% of mass) is weak and not explained.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: h, f, e, b, d, 3; least: r, 0, t, 2) and the previous input (most: x, h, 1, e, y, d; least: 0, u, g, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, L=6 & t=5, L=5 & t=4.
